title: Now tree priority chips lose color from invalid CSS
description:
## Bug

Ryan reports Now summary styling is broken. Live repro shows Now tree rows with washed-out or missing priority colors and low-contrast gray IDs/icons.

Board cards and Now rows both use `.issue-accent-priority` with `--issue-priority-bg` from `buildIssueColorStyle`. An invalid CSS block in `apps/console/src/styles/globals.css` mixes selectors with `@media`, so the dark-mode priority variable switch is dropped or applied at the wrong scope.

## Invalid CSS

```css
.dark .issue-accent-priority,
[data-theme='dark'] .issue-accent-priority,
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  --issue-priority-bg: var(--issue-priority-bg-dark);
}
```

This was introduced when `html.light` / `html.dark` rules were rewritten. Theme switching now sets `html.dark` / `html.light` in `useAppearance`, matching `.issue-card` and `.status-tree-row`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  row[".status-tree-row sets --issue-priority-bg"]
  chip[".issue-accent-priority uses background: var(--issue-priority-bg)"]
  bad["Invalid selector-plus-@media rule"]
  row --> chip
  bad -->|"parse error / wrong scope"| chip
```

## Expected behavior

```
Feature: Console Now tree priority chips
  Scenario: Priority chips use valid dark-mode CSS
    Given the console globals stylesheet is loaded
    When the Now tree renders an issue row
    Then the priority chip uses --issue-priority-bg as its background
    And dark mode switches --issue-priority-bg via .dark or data-theme=dark selectors
    And those selectors are not mixed with an @media rule
```

## Definition of Done

- Invalid `@media` mix is gone from `globals.css`
- Dark-mode switch matches `.issue-card` / `.status-tree-row` (`.dark` and `[data-theme='dark']`)
- Existing color-coding spec still passes
- Embedded console assets rebuilt if the repo commits them
- PR against develop
